# xterm.js

The SSH terminal uses the upstream npm distributions of [@xterm/xterm 5.5.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/xterm/v/5.5.0) and [@xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xterm/addon-fit/v/0.10.0).
